issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a method named printFarmSong() in Farm.java, but both the template and the solution define and use a method named singFarmSong() instead. This naming mismatch can confuse students (they may look for printFarmSong in the template or implement a method that isn't called) and may cause ambiguity when following the instructions or when running tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement to instruct implementation of singFarmSong() (and mention singFarmSongVerse) or change the template and solution to provide/expect a public printFarmSong() method that delegates to singFarmSong() (or rename singFarmSong() to printFarmSong()). Ensure the method name referenced in tests, template, and instructions matches exactly.
